articles.headline: Salesforce to acquire AI customer research startup Listen Labs in reported $2B deal
articles.summary: Salesforce agreed to acquire AI customer-research startup Listen Labs in a deal reportedly worth about $2 billion, although the companies did not disclose terms.
articles.why_it_matters: Listen Labs adds AI agents for customer research and Salesforce plans to apply the technology across Marketing Cloud and Service Cloud.

articles.headline: Salesforce Expands AI Bundles: Will Higher Adoption Boost ARR?
articles.summary: Zacks examines Salesforce's Core, Advanced and Max Agentforce editions and reports strong growth in Agentforce and Data 360 ARR.
articles.why_it_matters: The bundling strategy could accelerate enterprise AI adoption and increase recurring revenue.

articles.headline: Rethinking Salesforce Security: From One-Time Scoping to Continuous Monitoring
articles.summary: ISACA analyzes Salesforce security risks involving connected applications, credentials and excessive permissions.
articles.why_it_matters: The analysis highlights the importance of identity governance, integration security and configuration controls in Salesforce environments.

articles.headline: Salesforce outage on 2026-10-06
articles.summary: Salesforce experienced multiple incidents on 6 October 2026, including a prolonged Data 360 degradation affecting some customers.
articles.why_it_matters: Extended service degradation can affect customers relying on Salesforce data, analytics and downstream workflows.

articles.headline: From Autonomy to Accountability: How to Think About Trust in the Multi-Agent Future
articles.summary: Salesforce outlines security and governance principles for interoperable multi-agent systems.
articles.why_it_matters: The approach highlights identity, memory isolation, verification and human controls as important to enterprise multi-agent adoption.
